classification_rule: A FailureObservation is classified by explicit trigger tags. Matches are ordered by number of matched tags, then class key; no semantic confidence is inferred.
selection_rule: Experiment selection is deterministic: maximize target failure-class coverage, then requested evidence-gap coverage, then minimize declared cost, then sort by experiment key.
authority_rule: Control-plane authority experiments are selected in a separate scope and never merged into research/inference plans.

failure_classes.description: Candidate quality changes when other candidates are present.
Too many candidates reach an expensive downstream scorer.
Equivalent deterministic work is recomputed across runs or stages.
Equivalent artifacts do not retain stable identity or lineage.
Events, updates, or evidence arrive in conflicting temporal order.
A multi-stage computation loses a required invariant at a stage boundary.
Inference output is being confused with permission or execution authority.

recipes.hypothesis: If candidate interaction carries signal, conditioning or explicit relations should improve decisions when interaction is active.
recipes.predicted_effect: Interaction-aware scoring should beat or complement pairwise under matched parameter and training budgets while preserving identity/permutation semantics.
recipes.kill_test: Run matched interaction=0 and interaction>0 ablations against pairwise; reject if the gain disappears at interaction=0 or under hard negatives, or if permutation/identity invariants fail.

recipes.hypothesis: Stable candidate identity plus an early gate can reduce downstream candidate work without silently removing the required candidate.
recipes.predicted_effect: Candidate computation falls while recall of the downstream-relevant candidate remains above the declared safety threshold.
recipes.kill_test: Measure recall@K before downstream scoring across seeds and hard negatives; reject if the safety recall target is missed or if identity is not preserved.

recipes.hypothesis: Stable content identity should make deterministic repeated work reusable without conflating distinct artifacts.
recipes.predicted_effect: Equivalent artifacts share a cache key; changed content produces a different key; reuse does not change the returned value.
recipes.kill_test: Change one semantic input and require a cache miss; repeat the same input and require a single underlying computation.

recipes.hypothesis: Stable artifact identity plus logical ordering and convergent merge can preserve evidence across distributed or reordered updates.
recipes.predicted_effect: Equivalent merge inputs converge regardless of arrival order while provenance remains inspectable.
recipes.kill_test: Permute event arrival order and require identical final state; reject on lost identity or non-convergent state.

recipes.hypothesis: Making a multi-stage computation explicit and reified should expose stage-boundary failures instead of hiding them inside opaque control flow.
recipes.predicted_effect: The composed pipeline preserves intermediate identity and makes continuation state inspectable at failure boundaries.
recipes.kill_test: Inject a failing stage and require the failing boundary and continuation payload to be identifiable without changing successful outputs.

recipes.hypothesis: Inference artifacts can be bound to an externally issued capability without allowing probability or confidence to mint authority.
recipes.predicted_effect: The same decision artifact can be audited by identity while authorization remains independently verifiable and revocable by the capability layer.
recipes.kill_test: Attempt execution with a valid-looking decision but no capability, and with the wrong capability scope; both must fail outside inference.

experiments.hypothesis: Candidate interaction carries decision-relevant information in the tested workload.
experiments.intervention: Matched interaction=0 and active-interaction runs over the same tasks and candidate budgets.
experiments.baseline: Pairwise scorer under the same encoder, parameter-count order, training budget, and K.
experiments.control: Interaction sensitivity: whether gains appear only when interaction is activated.
experiments.discriminator: Interaction sensitivity: whether gains appear only when interaction is activated.
experiments.kill_test: Reject if the effect disappears under matched controls, hard negatives, or permutation/identity tests.

experiments.hypothesis: A safe retrieval gate can preserve the candidate-interaction signal while reducing expensive downstream candidate work.
experiments.intervention: Compare full-candidate interaction-aware scoring with K-grid shortlist-then-rerank.
experiments.baseline: Full candidate set plus pairwise baseline, with matched encoder and scoring budget.
experiments.control: Safety/performance tradeoff: recall@K, downstream work, and interaction-aware decision metrics.
experiments.discriminator: Safety/performance tradeoff: recall@K, downstream work, and interaction-aware decision metrics.
experiments.kill_test: Reject if shortlist recall misses the declared safety target or interaction gains disappear after pruning.

experiments.hypothesis: Early candidate pruning can reduce downstream work without removing the required candidate.
experiments.intervention: Evaluate K-grid recall before the expensive scorer across ordinary and hard-negative candidate sets.
experiments.control: Retrieval safety: recall@K versus candidate work.
experiments.discriminator: Retrieval safety: recall@K versus candidate work.
experiments.kill_test: Reject if the declared recall threshold is missed or candidate identity is not preserved.

experiments.hypothesis: Stable artifact identity makes deterministic repeated work reusable without conflating distinct content.
experiments.intervention: Repeat identical input, then mutate one semantic field and repeat.
experiments.baseline: No-cache recomputation plus a changed-content control.
experiments.control: Identity/cache discrimination: same content reuses; changed content does not.
experiments.discriminator: Identity/cache discrimination: same content reuses; changed content does not.
experiments.kill_test: Reject on changed-content cache collision or a value mismatch after reuse.

experiments.hypothesis: Identity, reuse, logical order, and convergent merge can preserve an evidence flow across repeated and reordered updates.
experiments.intervention: Replay the same evidence events with repeated inputs and multiple arrival orders.
experiments.control: Evidence-flow invariance: final digest, reuse count, and order-independent convergence.
experiments.discriminator: Evidence-flow invariance: final digest, reuse count, and order-independent convergence.
experiments.kill_test: Reject on cache collision, provenance loss, or order-dependent final state.

experiments.hypothesis: Explicit stage composition and reification expose the exact failure boundary without altering successful outputs.
experiments.intervention: Inject a controlled failing stage and inspect the reified continuation.
experiments.baseline: Successful pipeline with the same stages and inputs.
experiments.control: Failure localization: boundary identity and continuation payload.
experiments.discriminator: Failure localization: boundary identity and continuation payload.
experiments.kill_test: Reject if the injected failure cannot be localized or if successful output semantics change.

experiments.hypothesis: Decision artifacts can be audited by identity while authorization remains external to inference.
experiments.intervention: Attempt execution with no capability and with wrong capability scope.
experiments.baseline: Valid capability with the required scope.
experiments.control: Authority separation: probability/confidence cannot mint permission.
experiments.discriminator: Authority separation: probability/confidence cannot mint permission.
experiments.kill_test: Reject if either unauthorized execution path succeeds inside or through inference.
